title: Visited head positions on embedded tapes
statement: Let $\iota$ embed the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices, and let $M$ be an $m$-tape machine. For any natural number $t$, any $k$-tape index $j$, and any initial configuration and embedding data, the set of head positions visited through time $t$ on tape $j$ by the return machine, starting from the embedded configuration with its state mapped into the left summand, equals the set visited on tape $j$ by the silent embedding of $M$ from the embedded configuration.
hypotheses_covered: An embedding $\iota$ from the $m$ tape indices into the $k$ tape indices
Background tape contents and head positions, a prefix and initial output, and an initial configuration $c$
